description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified notification policy
name: GetNotifyPolicy

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. Used to isolate notification policy resources across different business spaces. Example: `default-cms-xxxx-ap-southeast-1`
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间 ID，用于隔离不同业务空间的通知策略资源。示例：`default-cms-xxxx-cn-hangzhou`
parameters.name: workspace

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the notification policy, returned by the create operation
parameters.help_zh: 通知策略的唯一标识，由创建接口返回
parameters.name: uuid
